title.narrative: Options Paper Concerning Implementation Modalities

description.narrative: Bankexecuted activity on developing analytical paper on HRMIS implementation modalities to inform Governments decision on HRMIS implementation option in Ukraine

comment.narrative: Options paper is prepared and shared with the Government.

The Options Paper prepared and issued by the Bank in early July 2017. It summarized the global experience concerning the automation of the human resource management function of the government. It also reviewed implementation challenges in Ukraine and advised on a methodology for choosing a software implementation modality. It informed the government decision for HRMIS implementation modality to follow in Ukraine with the procurement of a COTS solution with 2phased incremental functional development and institutional and user coverage.

comment.narrative: Subnational PEFA Assessments were conducted in Ukraine for the first time in close coordination with the EUfunded LOGICA Project. All subnational PEFAs were conducted in the same Khmelnytski oblast. The Bank covered Khmelnytski Oblast and Iziaslavskyi Rayon while the LOGICA Project Starosyniavska amalgamated hromada community. These measured the progress in implementing PFM reform at the subnational level and provided the Government with a baseline for future subnational PEFAs.In addition to national and two subnational PEFAs and in response to a request from the MoF a PEFA Assessment of genderresponsive budgeting GRB a newly developed supplementary module within the National PEFA Assessment was conducted by the Bank in 2020 with final report issued in July 2021. The genderresponsive PFM assessment was aimed at mainstreaming gender aspects in Ukraines PFM system establishing a baseline for future evaluations and informing relevant actions to the new PFM Reform Strategy.

title.narrative: Enhanced expenditure efficiency

comment.narrative: Subnational PEFA Assessments were conducted in Ukraine for the first time in close coordination with the EUfunded LOGICA Project. All subnational PEFAs were conducted in the same Khmelnytski oblast. The Bank covered Khmelnytski Oblast and Iziaslavskyi Rayon while the LOGICA Project Starosyniavska amalgamated hromada community. These measured the progress in implementing PFM reform at the subnational level and provided the Government with a baseline for future subnational PEFAs.In addition to national and two subnational PEFAs and in response to a request from the MoF a PEFA Assessment of genderresponsive budgeting GRB a newly developed supplementary module within the National PEFA Assessment was conducted by the Bank in 2020 with final report issued in July 2021. The genderresponsive PFM assessment was aimed at mainstreaming gender aspects in Ukraines PFM system establishing a baseline for future evaluations and informing relevant actions to the new PFM Reform Strategy.
